paragraphs.source_en: The lord of the castle was Oda Nobunaga—the fourteen-year-old Kippōshi who had celebrated his coming-of-age ceremony only that spring. His reputation within the Oda clan was exceedingly poor. Ever since his elder brother Nobuhiro had been sent to Anshō Castle, he had been praised for possessing both wisdom and courage; Nobunaga, meanwhile—the legitimate son who ought to inherit Nobuhide's legacy—was regarded as a hopeless fool. And yet Odai intended to meet the ill-reputed Nobunaga before paying her respects to Hirate Masahide...
